intro.title: Getting started
intro.body: Maintafox follows the maintenance cycle: a need is reported, turned into a job, carried out, and the results are analysed. The left menu groups modules by theme; each guide below explains what a module is for and where to start.
intro.step1: Look at the left menu to see the modules available for your role.
intro.step2: An intervention request reports a problem; a work order organises and tracks the work to do.
intro.step3: The lists offered in forms (types, statuses, causes…) come from Reference data.
intro.step4: Need a personal setting (language, password, notifications)? Open Settings.

good.title: Good to know
good.roles: What you see depends on your role. A module missing from the menu is not available with your role: ask an administrator to add it if you need it.
good.sync: Maintafox also works offline: your entries are saved on the device, then sent as soon as the connection is back. Sync status is shown in the top bar and in Settings › System & Sync.
good.docs: The plant's drawings, procedures and manuals are in the Document library, sorted by category. A document can also be linked to an asset and appear on its record.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.purpose: The starting point: a quick look at your plant's maintenance activity.
dashboard.step1: Read the indicators shown when the application opens.
dashboard.step2: Spot the items that are late or need action.
dashboard.step3: Open the relevant module from the menu to act.

requests.title: Intervention requests
requests.purpose: Report a problem or maintenance need and follow how it is handled.
requests.step2: Pick the asset concerned and describe the problem.
requests.step3: Set the urgency, then save the request.
requests.step4: Follow its progress; once approved, it can lead to a work order.

workOrders.title: Work orders
workOrders.purpose: Plan, carry out and close maintenance jobs.
workOrders.step1: Click "New WO" or start from an approved request.
workOrders.step2: Fill in the asset, the type of work and the urgency.
workOrders.step3: Assign the work and start it when the job begins.
workOrders.step4: Record what was done, then close the order.

planning.title: Planning
planning.purpose: Schedule jobs over time and balance crew workload.
planning.step1: Open the module to see the schedule for the period.
planning.step2: Spot the jobs that still need a slot or a new date.
planning.step3: Adjust dates to balance the workload.

pm.title: Preventive maintenance
pm.purpose: Define recurring maintenance plans to prevent breakdowns.
pm.step1: Open the list of preventive maintenance plans.
pm.step2: Create a plan by choosing the asset and the frequency.
pm.step4: Scheduled jobs then appear in work orders.

equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.purpose: The register of the plant's equipment and its history.
equipment.step1: Find an asset in the list or in the tree.
equipment.step2: Open its record to see its details, documents and history.
equipment.step3: Use "Create asset" to add a new one.
equipment.step4: From the record, create an intervention request or a work order.

inventory.title: Stores & purchasing
inventory.purpose: Manage spare parts, stock and the related purchases.
inventory.step1: Find a part in the item list.

permits.title: Work permits
permits.purpose: Control hazardous work with a permit approved before the job.
permits.step1: Open the list of current permits.
permits.step2: Create a permit stating the work and the location.
permits.step3: Follow its approval steps through to closure.

inspections.title: Rounds & checklists
inspections.purpose: Carry out inspection rounds with defined check points.
inspections.step2: Start a round and go through the check points.
inspections.step4: Finish the round to record its results.

personnel.title: Personnel
personnel.purpose: The register of maintenance people, crews and skills.
personnel.step1: Find a person in the list.
personnel.step2: Open their record to see their details and skills.
personnel.step3: Add or update people if your role allows it.

reliability.title: Reliability (RAMS)
reliability.purpose: Analyse asset reliability: lifetime, failures, causes.
reliability.step2: Choose an analysis method (Weibull, FMECA, RCM, Ishikawa).
reliability.step3: Check data quality first before interpreting results.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.purpose: Build dashboards and reports from maintenance data.
analytics.step2: Start from a report template to generate one.
analytics.step3: Browse the history of reports already produced.

admin.title: Administration
admin.purpose: Manage users, their roles and their access rights.
admin.step2: Create a user and give them a role.
admin.step3: Adjust roles and their rights if needed.

lookups.title: Reference data
lookups.purpose: The lists used across the application (types, statuses, categories…), defined once.
lookups.step1: Open the list you want to look at.
lookups.step2: Add or edit a value if your role allows it.
lookups.step3: Modules then use these values in their forms.

sync.title: Synchronisation
sync.purpose: Keep this device's data up to date with your company's server.
sync.step2: Check the status of the last synchronisation.
sync.step3: If something is wrong, use the diagnostics shown on that screen.

documentation.title: Document library
documentation.purpose: Find and add the plant's documents: drawings, procedures, manuals.
documentation.step1: Pick a category in the list on the left.
documentation.step3: Use "Add a document" to upload a new one.
documentation.step4: Link it to an asset to also find it on the asset's record.
